newsitem.title: UK: Ashquay sells shares in UK Estates.
newsitem.headline: Ashquay sells shares in UK Estates.

text.p: Britain's Ashquay Group Plc said on Wednesday it had agreed to sell 2,320,000 ordinary shares in UK Estates Plc after its bid for the property development firm failed on Tuesday.
Ashquay said it was now the beneficial owner of 3,365,050 ordinary shares representing 5.92 percent stake in UK Estates.
Ashquay said it sold the shares and its related rights to Close Brothers Corporate Finance Ltd, its financial advisers, for a price of 30 pence per share.
UK Estates closed a penny lower at 23 1/2 pence on Wednesday.
Ashquay's hostile bid for UK Estates failed on Tuesday after it had secured an interest in 26.0 million shares, or 45.78 percent, of UK Estates on Monday.
